limits: This inventory classifies official exported task/resource labels;it does not prove instruction-mode throughput, physical utilization or exclusive occupancy.
AICPU,AI Core,Vector,mixed kernels and communications are not one common MAC-capacity pool.
TASK durations may include waiting; sums across profiles/ranks/overlapping resources are not request latency.
TASK rows without COMPUTE metadata are inventoried,not declared zero-work or assigned arbitrary arithmetic.
